_comment: Verbatim from the live site. Note: the Stage 1 brief said 'keep all three' and then listed four — all four are kept here. Remove one if that was the intent.

items.quote: The sound healing experience grounded me in a way that I didn't even know I needed at the time. I was able to connect with my body and really use the time to heal and take stock of where I could use a little care. Mayana has such a stable and generous voice and David plays the sound bowls so skillfully and intuitively. A beautiful pairing that shifted me in a noticeable way. I was grateful for the session and look forward to participating in another!
Thank you, Mayana. This meditation brought me to a place I didn't expect and brought tears to my eyes.
Relaxing music and smooth lovely voice. Great for briefly helping to ground and look inward. Thank you!
Great start to the day (or finish) Thank you.
